newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Chronology of earthquakes in Pakistan.
newsitem.headline: Chronology of earthquakes in Pakistan.

text.p: At least 40 people were killed and dozens injured in an earthquake that hit Pakistan's southwestern province of Baluchistan on Friday, officials said.
Here is a chronology of previous major earthquakes in Pakistan:
May 31, 1935: Earthquake measuring 7.5 on Richter scale flattens Quetta, killing at least 30,000 people.
Dec 28, 1974: Earthquake kills 5,200 people and injures 16,000 in nine towns in Northern Areas. Thousands of homes are damaged
Sept 12, 1981: Earthquake measuring 5.7 on Richter scale kills 220 people and injures 2,000 in Northern Areas.
Dec 31, 1983: Earthquake measuring 7.0 on Richter scale kills eight people killed in Chitral.
Jan 3, 1984: Earthquake measuring 6.5 on Richter scale kills 12 people and destroys 400 houses in Chitral area.
Feb 1, 1991: Earthquake measuring 6.8 on Richter scale kills at least 175 Pakistanis and 200 Afghans on both sides of border.
May 21, 1992: Earthquake measuring 5.5 on Richter scale kills 36 people and injures 100 in Kohat, destroying at least 400 houses.
Oct 25, 1990: Earthquake measuring 6.0 on Richter scale kills 13 people and injures 300 in Peshawar.
March 5, 1990: Earthquake measuring 6.0 on Richter scale kills five people in Kalat area of Baluchistan.
